subject: Post-call: Multilingual evals & model recommendations for Globex Retail
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena M�fcller <lena.mueller@globexretail.de>, Kenji Sato <k.sato@zenith-retail.jp>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Multilingual evals & model recommendations for Globex Retail

Hi Lena / Kenji ������- thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary:
- Goal: High-quality customer support summarization and FAQ generation across 6 EU locales (DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, SV) plus JP and KO for APAC pilots.
- Current pain: inconsistent translations and hallucinations on locale-specific entity names; latency SLO of <= 250ms median for short responses.
- Data: You have ~1.2M support tickets (50% locale-labeled), sample prompt/response pairs shared on the call.

Redwood recommendation (shortlist):
- Primary candidate: LlamaX-13B-q4f (quantized) ������- best balance for multilingual generation and cost for mid-length responses.
- Fallback for high-accuracy/lower hallucination cases: Mosaic-MT-34B-FT (fine-tuned variant) ������- higher cost but better entity fidelity in FR/DE.
- Embeddings: use Redwood-embed-multilingual-v1 for cross-locale retrieval QA.

Materials attached:
- globex-eval-summary-v1.pdf (summary of quick evals we ran on your sample set)
- prompt-set-globex.zip (seed prompts and locale-specific variants)
- latency-benchmarks.csv (local latency sweep on dedicated instance)

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Your team: confirm the 3 locales to prioritize for an APAC+EU pilot (suggest DE, FR, JP).
2) Redwood: run a 48-hour model-run on an anonymized 10k sample (we'll run both LlamaX-13B-q4f and Mosaic-MT-34B-FT).
3) Technical sync: 45min on Mon Jul 5 to walk through eval metrics and tradeoffs.

Questions for you before we run the evals:
- Do you want entity-preservation as a hard constraint (we can run with stricter decoding/penalties)?
- Any latency budget updates for EU endpoints vs APAC?

Attachment: globex-eval-summary-v1.pdf, prompt-set-globex.zip

Thanks ����
Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 17:48:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Post-call: Multilingual evals & model recommendations for Globex Retail

Hi Marissa ������- thanks for the clear recap. A few quick clarifications: 

1) Locales: confirmed ������- DE, FR, JP for the pilot. We'll follow up if we want NL later.
2) Entity-preservation: very important for legal/brand names in DE and JP. If there is a configurable decoding penalty to reduce hallucinations, please enable it.
3) Latency: our internal SLA target is 200ms median for EU; APAC can be 250ms for now.

We approved the anonymized 10k sample for the eval ������- I've attached the EULA & redaction checklist (separately via shared drive link). Please proceed.

Also: can you include a short prompt set optimized for short ticket summaries (2-3 sentences)?

Best,
Lena M�fcller
Head of CX Automation | Globex Retail
lena.mueller@globexretail.de

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena M�fcller <lena.mueller@globexretail.de>, Kenji Sato <k.sato@zenith-retail.jp>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Multilingual evals & model recommendations for Globex Retail

Thanks Lena ������- confirmed on locales and constraints. We will: 
- Turn on stricter entity-preservation penalties for DE/JP runs.
- Run two models across the 10k anonymized sample and surface per-locale precision/recall on entity extraction, hallucination rate, ROUGE-L for summary quality, and latency percentiles.

Deliverables (within 48 hours of sample ingest):
- Per-locale evaluation CSV and consolidated dashboard link.
- Prompt-set optimized for 2-3 sentence ticket summaries (attached in prompt-set-globex.zip).
- Recommendation doc pointing to the preferred model per locale + cost delta.

Quick notes on benchmarks and where to look: 
- Benchmark report: https://docs.redwood.ai/benchmarks/multilingual-eval-2027 (we'll add a Globex-specific section after runs).
- Quick prompt recipes: included in prompt-set-globex.zip -> /short-summary-templates.md

Proposed time for the technical sync: Mon Jul 5, 09:00 CEST / 00:00 PT. I'll send a calendar invite after we confirm.

Attachment: prompt-set-globex.zip, latency-benchmarks.csv (initial run)

Best,
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Globex pilot ������- eval run plan and region-specific QA

Team ������- looping you in with the external ask. TL;DR: 10k anonymized sample, DE/FR/JP priority, strict entity-preservation for DE/JP, latency target 200ms median EU.

Plan: 
- Neha: please provision a dedicated q4f LlamaX-13B instance in our eu-west-1 cluster and a Mosaic-MT-34B-FT instance in our apac-east-1 test pool. Use the optimized kernel set and enable KV prefix caching for short-summary tests.
- Vivek: ensure we apply the decoding penalties and tie the eval to the hallucination metric in our test harness (suppress_topk=... we discussed). Add entity-verbatim check for brand/legal terms.
- Rishi: include per-locale tokenization checks (GER compound words) and an additional post-processing normalization step for dates/currencies.
- Monica: commercial lead ������- I'll flag potential cost delta in the report; we may recommend LlamaX for cost-sensitive flows and Mosaic for mission-critical accuracy.

Attachments to push with run: prompt-set-globex.zip, globex-eval-summary-v1.pdf

Please confirm by EOD and I'll ingest the sample once legal confirms the drive share.

-Marissa
